title: The market message: Focus on the leaders!

observed_trades.setup: Holding IBIT bought lower on the chart; sees no reason to do anything with it.
observed_trades.quote: I I don't think I bit's doing anything wrong, or there should be any reason for me to panic out of my position that I bought down here.
observed_trades.notes: 'Bought down here' points at the chart, no date. Also 'Bitcoin on the long side' (12:41).

observed_trades.setup: Still short GDX as it floats lower; not covering.
observed_trades.quote: GDX on the short side continues to just float lower, so there's no real reason for me to, you know, just randomly cover.
observed_trades.notes: Also 'gold on the short side' (12:41). No vehicle named.

observed_trades.setup: Okta is one of the positions he has had open for a while and it is acting phenomenally.
observed_trades.quote: I'm at least gaining some traction on my names that I've had open for a little while, whether it be gold on the short side, Bitcoin on the long side, uh AMD and Octa phenomenal
observed_trades.notes: Also 'the names in my portfolio ... outside of AMD and Okta ... slightly red today' (00:47) and 'Okta has been unbelievable' (01:20).

observed_trades.setup: Holding AMD, which he sees as the market leader; gap down today reversed into a bullish engulfing off the 5-day. Thinks it wants to go to 800.
observed_trades.quote: am I just supposed to randomly sell my AMD up here because it's having a teeny tiny red day? No.
observed_trades.notes: At 08:23 his only regret is 'I didn't buy more on Monday the 13th ... Monday the 14th', which implies the entry was Monday 9/14; not logged as a separate row.

observed_trades.setup: Picked up the software ETF; acting well although Oracle is not helping, with gap-down reversals across the group today.
observed_trades.quote: Uh IGV, I think, do you know, this is acting well. I picked it up yesterday

observed_trades.setup: Bought PANW yesterday; pleased with today's action.
observed_trades.quote: Um and then PANW I bought yesterday. You can't really complain about that price action today.

observed_trades.setup: Small-cap washout trade: IWM/IWO flushed into the ascending 200-day with speculators crowded short; took a shot with risk anchored to the 200-day.
observed_trades.entry_basis: washout into the ascending 200-day, gap down then rally back
observed_trades.quote: And then I picked up some TNA. You know, you started to gap down, but then you started to rally back up.
observed_trades.notes: 'I shot my shot today on the IWO' (08:43) appears to be this same trade, described on the IWO chart; logged once, as TNA.

observed_trades.setup: Carried Dell overnight, got caught in the gap down and used a break of the 5-minute opening range low as his out; it rolled over.
observed_trades.stop: break of the 5-minute opening range low
observed_trades.quote: I tried some Dell. I I should have taken it off yesterday. I didn't. I got caught in the gap down and then I kind of used the 5-minute opening range break low.
observed_trades.notes: The sale is not said outright; it is inferred from 'I bought it again later' (13:06). When the original position was bought is not stated, only that it was on before today.

observed_trades.setup: Bought Dell back later in the day when it started to turn up; it pushed, then rejected and closed weak.
observed_trades.entry_basis: turn back up after the morning roll-over
observed_trades.quote: I tried Dell today. Um I tried Dell right in here. Um and then it, you know, started to push well, rejects right off red and starts to close weak.
observed_trades.notes: Reentry per 13:06: 'I bought it again later when it started to turn up. It started to look great and then it closed like crap.'

observed_trades.setup: Sold the Dell re-buy for a 60-70 cent gain because he did not like the close.
observed_trades.quote: I got out for like a I don't even know. Like a couple cent 70 cent or 60 cent gain. Um I didn't like the way it closed.
observed_trades.notes: Ticker Dell named at 04:35. The 60-70 cents is a per-share gain, not a price.

ambiguous_tickers.context: He bought TNA today (02:14) on a small-cap washout thesis shown on the IWM and IWO charts. Treated as the same trade, not a separate IWO position.
